correctness.rationale: The two-shell Walsh transform equals a+bK2, with exact Plancherel energy |a|²+binom(d,2)|b|². Every real sign-sector arc has strictly concave positive numerator, so every minimizer has a K2 zero. Euclidean Minkowski inequality and its equality conditions restrict all complex minimizers to a single real minimizing line. A uniformly bounded fourth moment establishes the compact Gaussian limit; a unique root of an explicit derivative H with sign H’=2phi(t)(t²-1)(t²-3) determines the sharp universal constant. Exact rational binomial and independent Walsh checks in bundled checker passed 503 cases. The computation is supplementary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The origin-plus-entire-weight-two sphere is a canonical small radially symmetric physical support on the Boolean cube, directly relevant to Walsh compressibility. The exact all-dimensional optimum, all complex equality cases, and strictly selected Gaussian limit show that every such signal occupies asymptotically at least c_*²≈0.301869 of full Fourier dimension in the Fourier-ratio sense. This is a motivated, nontrivial infinite family and a sharp extremizer theorem, not a single arbitrary finite census or a claimed recovery lower bound.
